result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **SignWell for affordability and simplicity, or DocuSign if you want the most established, widely recognized platform.** However, the best choice depends on how many contracts you send and what other business tools you use.

Here are the options I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. SignWell** (Best value)

# \$10/mo

Great for small businesses that need straightforward contracts, signature requests, templates, and document tracking without paying for enterprise features.

- Free plan: 3 documents/month
- Simple interface
- Affordable paid plans
- Good for independent businesses and small teams

Pricing generally shown with annual billing.

[Visit SignWell](https://www.signwell.com/)

---

![Vagas na Squadra – Squadra Digital](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IaP7Jkr2ymCV1KIs0LJHQGFaRuTPRHo-JzB2tP7wMr9jI-qHWc8Btme-HT0A_UsBIlp4XbN4SqYElo_xupzyU34mftiaJjWU23ihRn2-KDWAwWN1Pe85snMSmDHupCbEeqQGTL8ubG9Ixpdrv32hl_9Bwg9nvIryTjSjhn3u_C9qMTXuHbPCpilC1tXvDQny?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall)

# \$11/mo starting

Best if you want a well-established name that customers, vendors, and business partners are familiar with.

- Professional signature workflows
- Templates and automated reminders
- Extensive integrations
- Strong audit trails

**Watch out\:** Some plans limit annual signature requests.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales teams)

# \$19/user/mo starting

Ideal if you create proposals, estimates, quotes, and contracts that customers need to sign.

- Document creation
- Electronic signatures
- Proposal templates
- CRM integrations
- Payment collection capabilities

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for simplicity)

# \$15/mo starting

A clean, easy-to-use option for businesses that primarily need to send documents for signatures.

- Easy document signing
- Signature tracking
- Dropbox integration
- Reusable templates

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

(Best for PDF workflows)

# \$16.99/mo starting

Great if your business already works extensively with PDFs and Adobe Acrobat.

- PDF editing and signing
- Document management
- Signature workflows
- Business integrations

[Visit Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-sign.html)

Prices are approximate advertised starting prices, generally with annual billing. Plans, sending limits, and monthly billing rates vary. Sources: [dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.pandadoc.com](https://www.pandadoc.com/blog/best-electronic-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-e-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My comparison

| Software | Best use | My take |
|--------|--------|--------|
| SignWell | Everyday contracts | Best value |
| DocuSign | Professional agreements | Best established option |
| PandaDoc | Quotes and proposals | Best all-in-one |
| Dropbox Sign | Basic signing | Easiest alternative |
| Adobe Sign | PDF-heavy business | Best PDF integration |


## What I'd choose

If I were setting up a small business today\:

- **1–5 employees\:** SignWell.
- **Growing business with regular contracts\:** DocuSign.
- **Service business sending estimates and proposals\:** PandaDoc.
- **Business that just needs customers to sign PDFs\:** Dropbox Sign.

One important consideration: Make sure the platform provides an audit trail, signer authentication appropriate to your needs, document retention, and compliance with applicable electronic signature laws, such as the US ESIGN Act and UETA.

## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your business.

I have three questions\:

**1\. What type of business do you operate?**

---

**2\. Approximately how many documents need signatures each month?**

---

**3\. What's most important?**

[Find my best option]

I'll use those answers to recommend the best software and the specific subscription plan, rather than having you pay for features your business doesn't need.
